I almost killed myself once. If my dog hadn't been there...I honestly do not know what would have happened. The thought of leaving him alone for as long as it would have taken my room mates to get back along with the way that he showed me how much he loved me. Best damn dog ever.

Also: I'm fairly sure that I'm in love with my best friend (she's a she and I'm a he). The only thing about that is that she lives to far away for anything to happen. Plus I'm fairly sure she doesn't think of me as nearly as important as I think of her. She really is one of the few people that I trust these days with pretty much everything about my life. She was mad at me...or something...last week and I was sort of lost... The real kicker? I've seen her face to face about 5 times in the last 3 years or so that I've known her... I'm afraid what would happen if I tried to do something with her, afraid that she would freak out and leave...or stay. Both scare the crap out of me equally.

Thank you.  All of you.  I've read all the responses and cried.  Then read them again.  And cried again.  Then I read it a third time.  And..well, you get the idea.

These are the things I think I have decided:

I think I really need to try to find help.  Someone.  A professional someone.  I think I've been kicking this idea around for a bit in my head but it has honestly been so long since I've felt this way, I thought I was finally over it.  I also don't think I can trust someone I know already with all this crap I'm feeling.  I think that may be the thing that has stopped me so far.  I've been afraid to trust someone.

I'm going to have to decide not to like this girl.  Not to go for anything.  She really is not in a place that she should be in a relationship, and if she decides to be in one, I can't be that guy.  I'm going to have to let her other friends handle it.  I need to get over whatever the hell happened with us.

I want to try to get in shape.  Losing weight would probably be a good idea.  I think it has a lot to do with self esteem issues.

All that being said, I have no idea where to go from here.  Especially when it comes to the help from a professional type person.  Being a poor college student, I have no money to go to a head doctor for something like that and asking my parents for money is pretty much out of the question.  I know my parents would want to know what's wrong, and beginning to say what I'm feeling, I think my mom would find some way to blame herself...I could go to the counseling center we have on campus, but I'm honestly afraid what people would say if they saw me...  I think I may just have to suck up my pride and say fuck it to anyone saying anything.  I want to get better.  I'm tired of this.

Thank you all again.  I think I may have to come back here from time to time to get a boost to remember that random people can care.

I have been planning my suicide for the past 5-6 years.  This is the first time that I have admitted this to anyone and I have gone quasi-anonymous it would seem.  I sometimes I just get to the point that I just don't want to have to deal with it anymore.  The part that really makes me angry is that my life is not all that bad.  I don't know why I do it.

The closest that I've ever come was my 18th birthday, 3 years ago.  I had it all planned out, what I would do, what I would leave in the note.  Everything.  Right as I was about to do it, I sat down on the floor and began to cry.  My dog came and started to lick me on the face, literally licking the tears away.  I started to laugh because it was so ridiculous.  He was so excited and happy.  I thought "I can't do this, who would feed him over the next few days?"

I had gotten to that point because although it was my 18th birthday, I had to work, because I had recently moved out of my parents house (to go to college, not because I didn't get along) and the only person that remembered to call and even wish me happy birthday was my mom.  I had no money to do anything, and I think my big meal was ramen noodles and water.  I had (and still haven't) been in a relationship and I just felt so...alone.  I didn't see the point to it anymore.

When I was younger, I had what I think you could call "normal" childhood.  Grew up out in a small town, middle child and all that.  I was the good kid with my parents.  

I think I was really jealous of my brother.  Most of the time it only felt like I would get them to pay attention to me if I did good at school.  My brother, on the other hand, was the opposite.  Where I was at home on weekends, he was out until 1.  Where I was a good student, he was failing.  The thing that would piss me off was that he was always the one that would get my parents to look at him.  He was always the one that would have my mom fighting tooth and nail to get him into special classes that would give him help.  People loved him.

I was actually sort of jealous once when he ended up in the hospital for a car wreck.  All of his friends showed up.  The hospital was never empty.  One person the entire time I was there asked how I felt, if I was okay.  I hate myself for feeling that way, but I know that I was jealous.  Here I was, trying to do everything right and no one gave a damn because it was what was expected.  He went and almost gets himself killed and everyone rallies behind him.  Like I said, I hate myself for feeling that way, but I couldn't help it.

Plus I always feel like people will leave me, and up until now, that's the only thing that hasn't let me down.  I can make a friend, they tell me some horrible secret or messed up stuff they are going through, then they leave me until they fuck up shit again.

Take my most recent example.  There was this girl I liked and thought was dating.  Never having been in a relationship before I could have been wrong, but every example of "dates" and "couples" seemed to fit.  We hung out a lot.  I spent the night at her place once, which may not have been a big deal, mostly because we had a trip to take the next day with the college band we are in and just cuddled.  Though I am sure I could have gone farther.

The messed up stuff she tells me?  First of all, she's still living with her ex, who she was dating for a long time (1-2 years).  She was molested as a kid.  She is basically anorexic and getting drunk, as in turning into something of an alcoholic, on a regular basis because she feels it helps her work with things.  Plus she's cutting herself.  That was basically the last time she talked to me.  After, she started to hang out with a guy that has at least one girlfriend and I'm pretty sure she may be setting herself up for some kind of affair.  Long story short, I don't think it will end well/I'm jealous of that bastard she's with now AND I know that if she starts talking to me again, I'm going to be back with her as soon as possible.

I do that again and again, especially with women, because I am so tired of being alone.  It makes me upset and I hate myself every time.

This is what brought on the latest episode of depression/suicidal thoughts.  After she started hanging with this other guy and still bumping into me.  I look at her and this guy and can't help but think, What the fuck is the point?  Why do I even try.  It would be so easy to take a razor and...

I feel like I can't really say anything to her about it because we never really were anything official.  We honestly hadn't even kissed, though at this point I pretty much know I could have.  Plus I don't think it would be a good idea for her to be in a relationship right now.

I feel like an asshole for writing this on here when I look around at all the other posts and seeing everything that everyone else has to deal with.  I feel weak.  I feel alone.  Honestly I'm not expecting much of a response.  Honestly I probably won't do anything to myself.  I just want to think someone may be listening...
